model.empty_no_key: No API key is saved. Save a provider's key in Settings and the models will appear here.
model.fal-kling-v3-turbo-pro.note: The most expensive fal tier (28 credits/s); the resolution cannot be chosen and the aspect ratio only takes effect on the text endpoint.
model.fal-pixverse-c1.note: The cheapest fal tier; it can also produce clips of up to 15 seconds.
model.fal-wan-3-0.note: At 480p the per-second cost drops below PixVerse; at the default 720p it is fal's middle tier.
model.gemini-3.7-flash.note: Speaks through Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint; fast and cheap.
model.gemini-nano-banana-2.note: The fastest turn; you pick a ratio (not pixels). For drafts.
model.gemini-nano-banana-pro.note: Brand consistency and long text layout; expensive but the most faithful.
model.gemini-veo-3-1-fast.note: A balance between speed and quality; it generates the audio itself.
model.gemini-veo-3-1-lite.note: The cheapest Veo. Billing must be ENABLED on your Gemini key.
model.gemini-veo-3-1.note: The best Veo, with 1080p enabled. Expensive per second — watch the duration.
model.openai-gpt-5.6-luna.note: The cheapest and fastest tier; for short turns.
model.openai-gpt-5.6-sol.note: The strongest and most expensive of the family; for long, tightly constrained briefs.
model.openai-gpt-5.6-terra.note: A balanced tier — the default for everyday briefs.
model.openai-gpt-image-1.note: Do not pick: it is retired from the API on 23 October 2026. Switch to gpt-image-2.
model.openai-gpt-image-2.note: The same model as on Azure, with your own key — pick this if you have no enterprise resource.
